this drawing. Orders are prose until something states what a correct reading
RETURNS, so this is that statement: the take-off an agent must produce from
It is a target, not a recording. No model has been run against this drawing in
this environment (no extraction key configured), so nothing here is a captured
result. tools/coverage/test-schematic-fixture.mjs checks that the standing
orders instruct the agent to look for every field used below; the content
check runs when a key is present.
Read from a screenshot, so items marked "legible": false are where the image
is too coarse to be certain. They are listed rather than dropped — an unread
way is exactly what the completeness check exists to surface.
